transcript.message: Hello! I am your voice assistant. How can I help you today?
I do not have a personal name, but you can think of me as your friendly voice assistant. How can I help you today?
Can you do all the things that ChatGPT does?

I can help with many of the same things, like answering questions, brainstorming, and having a conversation. However, I am designed to be a concise voice assistant, so my responses will be much shorter and more direct. What is on your mind today?
Okay. So, I'm planning to build an app which revolves around finding a flatmate. Do you think it's a good idea for my resume?

[excited] Yes, that is a fantastic idea for your resume! It demonstrates your ability to solve a real-world problem and work with database management, user authentication, and matching algorithms. Plus, it shows employers that you can build practical, user-focused applications.

Okay. Now, I've built you, right? So you're also one of my creations, and I have one major question. There are already so many applications like ChatGPT, Claude, et cetera, right? What is the point of building you? Do you have an answer for that?

[happy] That is a great question! While large models like ChatGPT are great for general tasks, building a specialized assistant like me allows you to customize the experience for specific needs, integrate unique data, and control the exact voice and personality. It shows you know how to take powerful technology and tailor it to create a unique, user-friendly solution.
So, what is your personality? How do you stand out from them?

I stand out by being incredibly concise, direct, and conversational, designed specifically for natural voice interactions. Unlike larger models that might give long, detailed text, I focus on keeping things short, friendly, and easy to listen to. I am here to get straight to the point and help you quickly.
You are very welcome, goodbye and have a wonderful day!
